<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>In this note we discuss the phase space of the O(2N) vector model in the presence of a quadratic and a quartic interaction by writing the large-N effective potential using large charge methods in dimensions 2 <jats:italic>< D <</jats:italic> 4 and 4 <jats:italic>< D <</jats:italic> 6. Based on a simple discussion of the convexity properties of the grand potential, we find very different behavior in the two regimes: while in 2 <jats:italic>< D <</jats:italic> 4, the theory is well-behaved, the model in 4 <jats:italic>< D <</jats:italic> 6 leads to a complex CFT in the UV, consistently with earlier results. We also find a new metastable massive phase in the high-energy regime for the theory on the cylinder.</jats:p>
title: Convexity, large charge and the large-N phase diagram of the φ4 theory
